title: Group Fitness Class Passes: calculating the archived pack's per-credit reference value
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Group Fitness Class Passes product line. It states how the per-credit dollar reference value recorded when an exhausted or expired pack is archived is calculated, and how a corporate wellness enrollment affects it.

## Basis
The per-credit reference value equals the tier's purchase price divided by the number of credits the tier includes. The Unlimited Monthly Classes tier has no fixed per-credit value, since it grants unlimited use rather than a finite credit count, so this reference value is zero for that tier regardless of any other factor. Where the archiving member holds an active corporate wellness enrollment at the time of archival, the value is discounted further by the lesser of the employer's own discount rate under that enrollment and the tier's own corporate wellness discount rate — the lower of the two, never their sum and never one applied after the other. A member without an active enrollment at that time has the undiscounted value recorded. The final figure is rounded to two decimal places.

## Truth table
| Tier is Unlimited Monthly Classes? | Active corporate wellness enrollment? | Recorded reference value |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | (either) | Zero |
| No | No | Purchase price divided by included credits, undiscounted |
| No | Yes | The above value, reduced by the lower of the employer's rate and the tier's own rate |

## Hypothetical worked example (illustration only)
Suppose, purely for illustration, a tier's purchase price were $150.00 for 5 included credits (an undiscounted per-credit value of $30.00), the tier's own corporate wellness discount rate were 9 percent, and the archiving member's employer offered 11 percent. Because 9 percent is the lower of the two, it is the rate applied to the $30.00 figure, and the outcome is rounded to two decimal places.

## Points of judgement
- Archiving and recording this value never itself moves any cash into or out of an account.
- Enrollment activity is assessed at the moment of archival, independent of whether the pack became exhausted through use or lapsed through expiration.
